name: vsa_block_sparse_attention_d128_bf16
description: Video Sparse Attention (VSA) block-sparse prefill with the flashinfer BlockSparseAttentionWrapper vsa_blackwell / vsa_blackwell_blk64 contract that flashinfer PR #4593's Cake VSA backend implements: bf16 D=128 q/k/v in [S, H, D] with native heads, square 64- or 128-token blocks (MB = NB = S / block_size), no causal mask. Sparsity is given natively as q2k_indices int32 [H, MB, topk] (the distinct KV blocks each head's query block attends to; uniform top-k, every row selects >= 1 block) plus, on 64-token-block rows only, kv_block_lens int32 [NB] in [1, block_size] giving the valid tokens at the front of each KV block (FastWan partial tiles; None when every block is full). The output is [S, H, D] bf16 and only the output is returned (the long-sequence Cake route has no LSE). Workloads: PR #4612's blk128 compress-top-k sweep (S=16384/32768/80000, H=8), its blk64 head-shared random-BSR sweep (S=1024/2048/4096 at 25/50/75% density), and two FastWan (Wan2.1-1.3B, 12 heads) rows at sparsity 0.8, one with 52 partial 32-token blocks.

seq_len.description: Query and key/value tokens (S = M = N); a multiple of block_size.

block_size.description: Square block size R = C, 64 or 128.

topk.description: KV blocks selected per (head, query block).

head_shared_mask.description: 1 when every head uses the same block list (PR #4612 blk64 BSR recipe), 0 for per-head pooled top-k.

num_partial_blocks.description: KV blocks with fewer than block_size valid tokens (0: kv_block_lens is None).

partial_block_len.description: Valid tokens in each partial block (0 when there are none).

constraints: 1 <= topk <= num_blocks; block ids within a q2k_indices row are distinct and in [0, num_blocks)
num_partial_blocks == 0 implies kv_block_lens is None; block_size == 128 implies kv_block_lens is None

q2k_indices.description: KV block ids attended by each (head, query block); ascending within a row.

kv_block_lens.description: Valid tokens at the front of each KV block, in [1, block_size]; None when all blocks are full.

block_size.description: Query and KV block size (64 or 128).

output.description: Attention output over the selected blocks' valid keys; a fresh tensor.

reference:
import math

import torch


@torch.no_grad()
def run(q, k, v, q2k_indices, kv_block_lens, block_size, sm_scale):
    """
    VSA block-sparse attention (flashinfer BlockSparseAttentionWrapper
    vsa_blackwell / cake_vsa semantics) in fp32, a chunk of query blocks at
    a time:

    • q, k, v are [S, H, D] with native heads (Hq == Hkv); square
      block_size x block_size tiles, MB = NB = S // block_size; no causal
      mask, no positional encoding.
    • q2k_indices [H, MB, topk] int32 lists, per head and query block, the
      distinct KV blocks that query block attends to (every row selects at
      least one block). Every token of a selected block is a key, except
      that when kv_block_lens[block] < block_size only the first
      kv_block_lens[block] tokens of that block are valid (padding tail).
    • out[s, h] = softmax(sm_scale * q[s, h] . k[keys, h]) @ v[keys, h] over
      the valid keys of the blocks selected for s's query block; padded
      query rows are computed like any other row. sm_scale None means
      1/sqrt(D). The output has q's dtype.
    """

    S, H, D = q.shape
    B = int(block_size)
    MB, NB = S // B, k.shape[0] // B
    topk = q2k_indices.shape[-1]
    scale = float(sm_scale) if sm_scale is not None else 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)
    device = q.device
    heads = torch.arange(H, device=device)[:, None, None]
    idx = q2k_indices.to(device=device, dtype=torch.int64)  # [H, MB, topk]
    qh = q.float().view(MB, B, H, D).permute(2, 0, 1, 3)  # [H, MB, B, D]
    kh = k.float().view(NB, B, H, D).permute(2, 0, 1, 3)  # [H, NB, B, D]
    vh = v.float().view(NB, B, H, D).permute(2, 0, 1, 3)
    valid = None
    if kv_block_lens is not None:
        lens = kv_block_lens.to(device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        valid = torch.arange(B, device=device)[None, :] < lens[:, None]  # [NB, B]
    out = torch.empty(H, MB, B, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    # ~64M gathered fp32 elements per chunk: ~1 GB peak at S=80000, 156 blocks/row.
    chunk = max(1, (64 << 20) // (H * topk * B * D))
    for start in range(0, MB, chunk):
        stop = min(start + chunk, MB)
        rows = idx[:, start:stop]  # [H, m, topk]
        keys = kh[heads, rows].flatten(2, 3)  # [H, m, topk*B, D]
        vals = vh[heads, rows].flatten(2, 3)
        scores = torch.einsum("hmrd,hmnd->hmrn", qh[:, start:stop], keys) * scale
        if valid is not None:
            dead = ~valid[rows].flatten(2, 3)[:, :, None, :]  # [H, m, 1, topk*B]
            scores = scores.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf"))
        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
        out[:, start:stop] = torch.einsum("hmrn,hmnd->hmrd", probs, vals)
    return out.permute(1, 2, 0, 3).reshape(S, H, D).to(q.dtype)
